title: Do you know where ...? I don't know what ... etc.
summary: Вежливые и косвенные вопросы: после **Do you know / I don't know / Can you tell me** порядок слов как в обычном предложении, без do/did.
ru:
## Обычный вопрос и косвенный вопрос
Обычный вопрос: **Where is Paula?** (глагол перед подлежащим). Но если мы начинаем с **Do you know ...**, **Can you tell me ...**, **I don't know ...**, порядок слов меняется: подлежащее идёт **перед** глаголом, как в утверждении.
> Where is Paula? → Do you know where **Paula is**? — Ты знаешь, где Паула?
> What time is it? → Can you tell me what time **it is**? — Подскажите, который час?
> How old is Linda? → I don't know how old **Linda is**. — Не знаю, сколько Линде лет.
- ~~Do you know where is Paula?~~ → Do you know where **Paula is**?

## Вопросы с do / does / did
В косвенной части вспомогательные **do / does / did исчезают**, а глагол принимает форму, как в утверждении.
> Where **does** he live? → Do you know where he **lives**? — Ты знаешь, где он живёт?
> What **did** she say? → I don't remember what she **said**. — Не помню, что она сказала.
> How **do** aeroplanes fly? → Do you know how aeroplanes **fly**?
- ~~Do you know where does he live?~~ → Do you know where he **lives**?

## Вопросы «да/нет»: if или whether
Если исходный вопрос начинается с **Is / Do / Can / Have ...**, добавляем **if** (или более формальное **whether**).
> Is Jack at home? → Do you know **if** Jack is at home? — Ты не знаешь, дома ли Джек?
> Can Brian swim? → I don't know **if** Brian can swim. — Не знаю, умеет ли Брайан плавать.
> Did anybody see you? → Can you tell me **whether** anybody saw you?

## Зачем это нужно
Такие фразы звучат вежливее, чем прямой вопрос: «Can you tell me where the station is?» вежливее, чем «Where is the station?».

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~Can you tell me where is the bank?~~ → Can you tell me where **the bank is**?
- ~~I don't know what does she want.~~ → I don't know what **she wants**.
- ~~Do you know can he swim?~~ → Do you know **if** he can swim?
В косвенной части знак вопроса не нужен, если фраза начинается с I know / I don't know.
en:
## Direct and indirect questions
A normal question puts the verb before the subject: **Where is Paula?** But after **Do you know ...**, **Can you tell me ...**, **I don't know ...** the word order is like a statement: subject + verb.
> Where is Paula? → Do you know where **Paula is**?
> What time is it? → Can you tell me what time **it is**?
> How old is Linda? → I don't know how old **Linda is**.
- ~~Do you know where is Paula?~~ → Do you know where **Paula is**?

## Questions with do / does / did
In the second part we don't use do, does or did. The verb has its normal form.
> Where **does** he live? → Do you know where he **lives**?
> What **did** she say? → I don't remember what she **said**.
> How **do** aeroplanes fly? → Do you know how aeroplanes **fly**?

## Yes/no questions: if or whether
When the direct question begins with Is / Do / Can / Have ..., we add **if** (or **whether**).
> Is Jack at home? → Do you know **if** Jack is at home?
> Can Brian swim? → I don't know **if** Brian can swim.
> Did anybody see you? → Can you tell me **whether** anybody saw you?

## Why use this?
It is more polite: *Can you tell me where the station is?* sounds nicer than *Where is the station?*

## Common mistakes
- ~~Can you tell me where is the bank?~~ → Can you tell me where **the bank is**?
- ~~I don't know what does she want.~~ → I don't know what **she wants**.
structure:
## Wh-вопросы
| Прямой вопрос | Косвенный |
|---|---|
| Where is the bank? | Do you know where **the bank is**? |
| What time is it? | Can you tell me what time **it is**? |
| Where can I park? | I don't know where **I can park**. |
| Where does he work? | I know where he **works**. |
| Why did she leave? | I don't know why she **left**. |

## Yes/no вопросы
| Прямой вопрос | Косвенный |
|---|---|
| Is Jack at home? | Do you know **if** Jack is at home? |
| Have they got a car? | I don't know **if** they have got a car. |
| Do they live here? | Do you know **whether** they live here? |

## Формула
> Do you know / Can you tell me / I don't know + **wh-слово + подлежащее + глагол**
> Do you know / I don't know + **if / whether + подлежащее + глагол**

## Правило
- Без do / does / did после wh-слова.
- Времена не меняются: does he live → he **lives**, did go → **went**.

exercises.title: I don't know where ...
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложение, поставив слова в правильный порядок.

items.text: Where is Kate? → I don't know where {{Kate is}}.
What time does the film start? → Do you know what time {{the film starts}}?
Where did they go? → I don't know where {{they went}}.
How much is this shirt? → Can you tell me how much {{this shirt is}}?
Why is he angry? → I don't know why {{he is angry|he's angry}}.
When does the bus leave? → Do you know when {{the bus leaves}}?
Is Tom at home? → Do you know {{if|whether}} Tom is at home?
Can Sara drive? → I don't know {{if|whether}} Sara can drive.
Does he like coffee? → Do you know {{if|whether}} he likes coffee?
Is the shop open? → Can you tell me {{if|whether}} the shop is open?
Did she call you? → I'm not sure {{if|whether}} she called you.
Have they got a car? → Do you know {{if|whether}} they have got a car?

options: where is the post office
where the post office is
where does the post office is
items.why: После wh-слова — порядок как в утверждении.

options: what does she want
what she wants
what she want
why did he leave
why he left
why he did leave
items.why: Без did; глагол в прошедшем: left.

items.q: Could you tell me ___ the museum is open on Monday?
options: that
if
what
where I put my keys
where did I put my keys
where I did put my keys
items.why: Без did: where I put my keys.

options: Do you know what time he comes?
Do you know what time does he come?
Do you know what time comes he?

exercises.title: Составьте вежливые вопросы
exercises.instruction: Начните со слов **Do you know ...** / **Can you tell me ...**.

answers: Do you know where the station is?
Can you tell me where the station is?
Do you know what time the shop opens?
Can you tell me what time the shop opens?
Do you know how much this bag is?
Can you tell me how much this bag is?
Do you know if the bank is open today?
Can you tell me if the bank is open today?
Do you know whether the bank is open today?
Can you tell me whether the bank is open today?

items.prompt: (Where did Anna go?) Начните с I don't know
answers: I don't know where Anna went.

exercises.title: Что вы знаете и чего не знаете
exercises.instruction: Допишите предложения о себе. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I know where the nearest bank is.
I don't know what the weather will be like tomorrow.
I don't remember when I started learning English.
Can you tell me how I can get to the station?
I'm not sure if I can come to the party.
